item.title: Top Reader: Ransom Middle Student Reads 1.755 Million Words In December
item.description: Paige Ruhnow was recognized at the December Accelerated Reader (AR) Top Reader at Ransom Middle School. Paige read 1,755,099 words and passed 20 AR tests. Photo for NorthEscambia.com, click to enlarge.
